name: Kinsus Interconnect Technology Corp.
summary: Kinsus Interconnect Technology Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of electronic products in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through the IC Substrate and Optics segments. The company offers system in package substrate, a carrier substrate that provides a platform for multiple chips or packages or passive components assembly for multi-chip module, multi-chip package, stack die, package in package, and embedded substrates, as well as modules in handset and wearable devices.
